notes.title: Now available in 6 more languages!
notes.content:
I am excited to announce that Hot Heat Reset: Chapter 1 is now available in 6 new languages:

- Spanish / Español
- Brazilian Portuguese / Português Brasileiro
- Russian / Русский
- Simplified Chinese / 简体中文
- Japanese / 日本語
- Korean / 한국어

Additionally, I have introduced some new visual features and fixed a few minor bugs:
- Added Shockwave Effect on the final block explosions
- Improved UI
- Improved Controller Support
- Fixed Level 2's fly-off bug

In case you encounter any bugs, linguistic errors or have any suggestions, start a new discussion in the Community Hub or ping me on the Discord server.

Also, don't forget to add the full game to your wishlist!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2197360/Hot_Heat_Reset

Thanks!
